critical_code_review_comments: news_service.classify() runs per article on every fetch — fine for current volume but consider precomputing/caching classification fields with the cached article doc so a heuristic rule change can be replayed without re-fetching RSS.
fetch_all_classified caps at 48 items but only takes 3 per topic from 22 topics → max ~66 before dedup; consider exposing per-topic cap via query param for richer feeds.

MarketIntelligencePage.jsx does live SEO via document.title + meta manipulation in useEffect — fine for SPA but consider react-helmet-async for cleanup on route change so MI title doesn't persist on back-navigation in some browsers.
Filter logic uses key parsing like 'cat:Infrastructure' on the client — works but a small enum/lookup table would be more robust against future label changes.
AmbientGlow is a fixed-position decorative div but lacks aria-hidden='true'; minor a11y polish.
/api/news/all is heavy on first hit (fans out to 22 RSS feeds in parallel). Add a soft TTL guard / loading state so frontend doesn't sit on a long pending request if RSS is throttled.
